text: POW!!! … Sorry. I say that every time the door opens. It’s in my contract.
I’m Bam. Everything here flashes, squeaks or falls over.

optionen.text: Why is the shop called POW!?

text: Three deals. New every day. I don’t roll dice for them — I ask the calendar.
Tomorrow they’ll be different. That’s not a threat, that’s a promise.
The GOOBY Snapper! Handmade. Well — machine-made, but by a machine with heart.
Snap anything: Gooby, the sunset, accidentally your own thumb.

optionen.text: What do I need it for?

text: No camera, no photo mode. No photo mode, no photos. No photos … only memories.
And memories fade. Photos just gather dust. Much more durable.
Ha! I knew it. Once you start snapping, you never stop.
My record is 400 photos of one street lamp. It was standing there so nicely.
POW! That’s the sound of fun hitting a shelf.
My accountant says it’s one exclamation mark too many. My accountant has never said POW.
Looking is free! Touching too. Knocking things over costs one smile.
I’ll put it back. I put things back all day long.
